parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=6 with MATRIX_LR=0.06 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 (implied) to reach val_bpb 1.0136. My run shows that DEPTH=6 and moderate LR are strong. Next, I'll test lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.05 on this D6/warmup base to see if it further improves convergence, following the lower-LR trend.
parsed.description: Testing DEPTH=6 with MATRIX_LR=0.05 and WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 to see if a slightly lower LR improves upon the current best.
